jobs_results.title: ENGINYER/A DE DISSENY ELECTRÒNIC DE HARDWARE
jobs_results.description:
Des de Marlex estem col·laborant amb una important empresa ubicada a la comarca d’Osona, dedicada al sector del metall, que actualment té la necessitat d’incorporar al seu equip a un/una Enginyer/a de Disseny Electrònic de Hardware.

Empresa dedicada a oferir serveis integrals de disseny i fabricació de sistemes i productes electrònics pel sector de l’automoció i el sector industrial:

Quina serà la teva missió a l’empresa?

En dependència del/la responsable de departament, la persona seleccionada s’ocuparà de:
• Desenvolupar hardwares electrònics per a dispositius mecatrònics.
• Elaborar les especificacions per desenvolupar i portar a terme el projecte.
• Definir el procés de disseny de layout dels productes electrònics.
• Dissenyar, desenvolupar i avaluar els prototips.
• Proposar millores per a donar un valor afegit al producte tenint en compte els avenços del mercat.
• Validar els diferents components electrònics seleccionats pel producte.
• Seleccionar nous components per a la... millora de producte.
• Encarregar-se de la documentació tècnica del projecte.

Al perfil seleccionat se li ofereix:
• Treballar en una empresa amb renom i ben consolidada dins els seu sector.
• Estabilitat i pla de carrera dins de l’empresa.
• Formació contínua interna.
• Horari flexible de dilluns a dijous en torn partit i divendres intensiu.
• Bon ambient de treball.

Requisits:

Ets el/la candidat/a ideal si tens...
• Formació en Enginyeria Industrial Electrònica, Telecomunicacions o similar.
• Experiència mínima de 3 anys en posició similar.
• Coneixements de llenguatge de programació.
• Experiència en disseny de layouts de PCB i en software de disseny Altium Designer.
• Experiència en verificació i avaluació de prototips.
• Es valorarà coneixements de software CAD mecànic.
• Nivell elevat d’anglès.
• Actitud proactiva, polivalent i capacitat de treball en equip

jobs_results.title: Hardware Field Service Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Together, we can beat cancer.

At Varian, a Siemens Healthineers Company, we bring together the world's best talent to realize our vision of a world without fear of cancer. Together, we work passionately to develop and deliver easy-to-use, efficient oncology solutions.

We are part of an incredible community of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, to improve people’s lives around the world. We embrace a culture of inclusivity in which the power and potential of every individual can be unleashed. We spark ideas that lead to positive impact and continued success.

If you want to be part of this important mission, we want to hear from you.

Main Location: Barcelona

Major Responsibilities
• Service and maintain complex Varian Medical Systems (VMS) products according to technical documentation provided.
• Instruct customers in operating and maintaining our products, to ensure customers/users are... self-sufficient in operating their equipment.
• Provide phone support / remote assistance to customers and to the Field Engineer as required.
• Order spare parts for assigned customers including replenishing spare parts kits for warranty and contract customers. Advise and assist customers in ordering spare parts or on service requests.
• Report by means of Field Service Reports/time sheets/expense reports etc. (as applicable) regularly / weekly.
• Input detailed records of service visits into company information systems, including technical problems, actions taken, and parts employed to correct these problems.
• Maintain up-to-date technical documentation, in order to permanently keep informed regarding all operating characteristics, design factors, technical performance, and developments of VMS products.
• Maintain a high degree of professional knowledge and safety consciousness according to our guidelines.

Qualifications And Experience
• Graduate or Bachelor of Technical Institute in electronics, electrical/biomedical engineering, related fields, or equivalent education.
• You bring 1 – 2 years of related experience preferred.
• Sound understanding of customers and their requirements as well as knowledge and application.
• Professional experience in electronic engineering, and testing equipment used for verification, checkout, and calibration of our products.
• Sound knowledge of and professional technical experience with microcomputers / PC-based systems.
• Articulate and skilled in interpersonal communication.
• Fluency in Spanish and English (other European languages desirable).
• Willing to work normal and non-normal hours as required to support the customers and to travel extensively (up to 60%, occasionally also abroad).

Varian is required to comply with all local and applicable regulations that may be associated with vaccine requirements for certain roles.

Fighting cancer calls for big ideas.

We envision a world without fear of cancer. Achieving this vision takes dedication and commitment from all of us, every single day. That's why we celebrate and value the distinctly beautiful and intersectional identities of each of our employees. We are a mirror of our patient-base, which allows us to innovate. Big ideas come from everywhere, and the best ideas are fostered by our unique individual experiences. At Varian, we encourage you to bring your whole self to work and believe your bold and authentic perspective will help to power more victories over cancer.

#TogetherWeFight

Privacy Statement

jobs_results.title: Hardware Engineer Internship
jobs_results.description:
Valeo ist ein globales Technologieunternehmen, das innovative Lösungen entwickelt, um die Mobilität neu zu erfinden. Wir sind ein Partner von Automobilherstellern und Akteuren der neuen Mobilität weltweit. Unsere Vision? Eine grünere und sicherere Mobilität zu erfinden, dank Lösungen, die sich auf intuitives Fahren und die Reduzierung von CO2-Emissionen konzentrieren. Wir sind führend in unseren Geschäftsbereichen und werden als eines der weltweit größten innovativen Unternehmen anerkannt.

Valeo Group is one of the world's largest Automotive suppliers which is an inspired company focused on innovative products, development and customer satisfaction. Working with us means managing the most advanced and sophisticated technologies.

Our Martos plant is one of the biggest sites within our Visibility Systems Business Group in charge of developing and manufacturing Lighting Products and Electronics, with around 3.000 employees. From the latest adaptive lighting technologies to intuitive... interior lighting solutions to stylish and design-centric external lighting, Valeo constantly innovates to improve comfort and safety for drivers and passengers alike.

Valeo is offering an Internship program within Hardware Area you will support the Department in the following tasks:
• Support in the management of project planning, allocation of resources and hours.
• Assist in ticket management
• Support Open Point Tracking
• Assisting with CoreALM Review

To be able to be selected for this internship, you need to fulfill the next requirements:
• Be result oriented, commitment to teamwork within an international environment.
• Professionalism and transparency.
• Geographical mobility.
• Passion for the automotive industry.
• Electronics Engineering.
• B2 English level is required - Mandatory

If you DO NOT meet all the requirements, don't worry, we want to meet you too!

Don´t miss the opportunity of joining us and take advantage of being part of an international company that commits to ethics, transparency, empowerment, professionalism and teamwork. Is that you? We want to know you!

• one of the largest global innovative companies, with more than 20,000 engineers working in Research & Development
• a multi-cultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration

• a business highly committed to limiting the environmental impact if its activities and ranked by Corporate Knights as the number one company in the automotive sector in terms of sustainable development

More information on Valeo: https://www.valeo.com

jobs_results.title: Flight Hardware Design Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

Job description:

Several positions of Flight Hardware Design Engineer are now open in Airbus CRISA (Airbus Defense & Space) in Tres Cantos (Madrid area) for different Space business: Launchers, Earth Exploration (Copernicus), Space Exploration (Artemis), Commercial (Telecommunications Satellites). This is an opportunity to join a diverse and dynamic Technical Team focused on:
• Shape the future based on innovation of our products, new technologies and way of working,
• State of the art product consolidation,
• Continuous Performance improvement.

Definitely, we are moved by our passion to make it fly!

In accordance with the proven Candidate skills, she/he will be part of Power, Analog or Digital team and will report/be supported by the relevant Skill Manager.

Functionally, the Candidate is also part of the Project, with the main mission of developing/designing electronic units for flight equipment to achieve the unit delivery in accordance with project schedule... cost and quality requirements. In a day-to-day basis, she/he will report to Project Manager.

Within each project, the tasks are coordinated by a Technical Responsible in charge of direct reporting to the Project Manager. The Engineer’s tasks comprise the complete development of an electronic equipment: from the analysis of the requirements to the final delivery of the flight model once accepted.

Task And Accountabilities

The successful applicant will be in charge of the following tasks:
• Support to the Technical Manager for the analysis of project requirements.
• Architecture analysis at electronic function or module level.
• Detailed electronics design based on electrical simulations at function level.
• Assure of the robustness of the design by means of: part stress analysis, worst case analysis, failure modes and criticality analysis, power budget analysis and Double Insulation requirements compliance.
• Support to Radiation Team to assure the design robustness within the radiation space environment including Single Events Effects (SEE).
• Documentation of the design.
• Laboratory and prototype testing.
• Assure the mechanical and thermal design robustness by supporting the Packaging Team.
• Support to PCB CAD team during the design of the PCB by the reviewing of the PCB layout.
• Board test procedures definition.
• Support to the Technical Manager in the main project reviews (Requirement Review, Preliminary and Architecture Review, Critical Design Review…)
• Characterization of the flight design in clean room conditions.
• Support to Test Team for the acceptance of flight equipment, ensuring a close monitoring of any change, evolution or discrepancy from the agreed baseline in the characterization phase.
• Support to the Technical Manager in the resolution of boards NCRs (Non-conformance) raised during qualification or acceptance test campaign.

Required Skills

We are looking for Candidates with the following skills and experience:
• Educated to Master degree level (or equivalent) in engineering or science discipline.
• Proven experience in the development of any of the following functions: Power, Analog or Digital electronics.
• Proven experience using advanced laboratory instrumentation.
• Good knowledge of design methodologies for space application and tools (Mentor, LTSPice, Matlab, SIMetrix-SIMPLIS).
• Sound mathematical basis for its application to the electronic design analysis.
• English and Spanish must be at least mid-level, both written and spoken.
• Good communication and reporting skills.
• Strong team working and cooperation spirit.
• Independent and accurate way of working.

Recommended Skills Are
• Digital mindset (automation of tasks, scripting, use of digital design tools and simulators).
• Knowledge of space environment constraints.
• To be familiar with Agile Methodologies.
• For Candidates with skills on Power & Analog electronics: experience on designs using digital control techniques.
• For Candidates with skills on Digital electronics: experience on designs based on hardware-software interfaces.
• Fast prototyping techniques.
• Happy to learn and teach others.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Company

Computadoras, Redes e Ingeniería, SA

Contract Type

Permanent

Experience Level

Professional

Job Family

Elec.Electron.&Electromag,Optics&Optron.

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking

jobs_results.title: Hardware Engineer / Electronic Design Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Clue keeps on growing!

We are now hiring a Hardware Electronic Engineer!

➪ About Clue

Clue is a company specialized in state-of-the-art embedded systems. We research, design, and manufacture high-performance electronic equipment, specifically crafted for critical environments in aviation.

Our motto is to create simple solutions to big problems.

➪ What is the job about?

The main responsibility of the Hardware Electronic Engineer is the research, design, and development of electronic devices for aviation applications.

The Hardware Electronic Engineer works in the HW team within the R&D department in a cross-disciplinary and international environment.

➪ What will you do?

✅ Join a hardware team that is working on the state of the art PCB electronic design.

✅ Plan, document and develop new hardware items from the initial specification and requirements through prototypes to production series.

✅ Designing circuit boards: from capturing schematics to layout (Support to PCB designer... or own layout), testing, and documentation.

✅ Ensure that PCB design meets design specifications.

✅ Work with the latest processors from NXP or Intel and the latest FPGAs from Xilinx and Microchip.

✅ Utilize high-performance technologies such as PCIe Gen 4, DDR4, Ethernet 10/40/100G...

✅ Design high-speed circuits with a high level of complexity in signal density, pushing the manufacturing capacity limits of top PCB manufacturers.

✅ Perform analysis, simulations, and design justifications for the technical architecture proposals.

✅ Support to system definition and regulatory and safety certification

✅ Design, validate and verify the hardware developments.

➪ What profile are we looking for?

Mandatory:
• Telecommunications, Industrial, Electronic Engineering Degree or any other Engineering Degree.
• Must be based in Spain and be willing to occasionally travel to Madrid or Málaga
• 5+ years of experience in the design of hardware products, prototyping, and debugging.
• PCB design over ECAD tools (preferably Altium)
• Experience designing complex, high velocity PCBs (at least 12 layers)
• Electronic simulations (LTSpice, TINA, Saturn…)
• SoC and FPGA designs (NXP, Xiilink, Intel, Microchip) and High-Speed interface designs.

Valuable:
• Relevant experience in an equivalent position in the aerospace industry.
• Background in developing hardware products for avionics equipment over DO-254.
• Background in reliability and safety activities.
• Understanding of EMI/EMC and environmental qualification activities over DO-160.

➪ What do we offer?

📝 Full-time, permanent contract

🛬 Final Company: We are NOT a consulting firm

⌚ Flexible schedule, work-life balance and free Friday afternoons

🏡 Remote work: work from anywhere in Spain with occasional trips to our offices in Madrid or Málaga

🍴 Free meals on days you come to the office

🎓 Training, certifications, and career development plan

🇬🇧 Free English classes

☕ Free coffee and snacks

🩺 Private health insurance

⛱ 25 + 2 vacations days

Clue is committed to the diversity of its teams and an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from people with different backgrounds, interests, and personal circumstances. Our team welcomes applicants regardless of their race, gender, age, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, and/or disabilities. All we need is your high energy, skills, and willingness to be part of a great project!

If you want to take your career to the next level, apply to our job offer

jobs_results.description:
Are you looking for an innovative and consolidated place for your professional development? GMV is an experienced technology group and your dream job might be with us!

We are expanding our teams in the satellites sector to take on Galileo's projects.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In our team you will contribute to the design of ground control equipment that coordinates the behavior of the fleet, carrying out activities of definition, documentation, supervision and verification of computer systems. Also the purchase and tracking of new hardware assets, the planning of tasks of external support teams.

The main task:
• Collaboration in the design of the technical solution
• Analysis and verification of compliance with both technical and project requirements
• Verification of compliance with European regulations and standards for IT systems
• Collaboration in the... supervision and inspection of external equipment
• Management of the materials (equipment, components..)

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

We are looking for experts hardware engineers interested in space with experience in IT projects and knowledge of IT regulations (UNE, DIN, ...) and experience in HPE system, CISCO, ARUBA, microelectronics, PLCs

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Laura Uribarren, in charge of this vacancy.

Laura Uribarren

jobs_results.title: Large Format Hardware Distribution Center Support Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Summary

This role is responsible for designing engineering solutions by applying developed subject matter knowledge. The role includes tasks such as creating cost estimates, time standards, and operational procedures for new product introductions. The role collaborates with stakeholders for compliance, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. The role contributes to developing reliable and cost-effective manufacturing solutions for moderately complex products.

Responsibilities
• Designs engineering solutions, including methods, operation sequences, and processes for the manufacturing of parts, component sub- assemblies, and final assemblies, based on established engineering principles and general specifications and requirements.
• Develops and implements cost estimates, capacity models, time standards, production area layouts, and recommendations for tooling and process requirements for new product introductions.
• Develops operating procedures, safety protocols, and... maintenance plans for large scale manufacturing equipment.
• Assists with issue diagnosis and problem-solving, while aiming for continuous improvement.
• Collaborates and communicates with management, internal, and outsourced manufacturing and development partners regarding process and standards compliance, recording and reporting issues, and recommendations for problem resolution for manufacture of existing products.
• Works as part of the project team of other manufacturing engineers and internal and outsourced manufacturing partners to develop and execute reliable, cost effective and high quality manufacturing solutions for moderately-complex products from new- product introduction through end of lifecycle.
• Represents the manufacturing engineering team for all phases of larger and more- complex development and manufacturing projects.
• Solves difficult and complex problems with fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
• Delivers professionally written reports, and supports realization of operational and strategic plans.
• Provides guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members to set an example of manufacturing engineering design and development innovation and excellence.

Education & Experience Recommended
• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in engineering design and solutions, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.

Preferred Certifications
• Six Sigma Certification
• American Production And Inventory Control Society (APICS) Certification

Knowledge & Skills
• Agile Methodology
• Automation
• Computer Science
• Continuous Improvement Process
• Data Analysis
• Electrical Engineering
• Engineering Management
• Lean Manufacturing
• Manufacturing Engineering
• Manufacturing Processes
• Mechanical Engineering
• New Product Development
• Process Improvement
• Project Management
• Python (Programming Language)
• Software Development
• Software Engineering
• Supply Chain
• Systems Engineering
• Tooling

Cross-Org Skills
• Effective Communication
• Results Orientation
• Learning Agility
• Digital Fluency
• Customer Centricity

Impact & Scope
• Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process.

Complexity
• Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.

Disclaimer
• This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

What We Offer
• Opportunity to work in an international organization with colleagues coming from all over the world.
• Diverse, continued internal growth and career opportunities. Including HP’s own learning platform and LinkedIn Learning.
• An attractive benefits package:
• Health & Life insurance
• Lunch at reduced prices at our canteen/ ticket restaurant vouchers
• HP product discount
• Work life balance / flexible working hours.
• Women, Pride, Young employees, Sustainability and DisAbility! Just a few of our fantastic global business networks you can get involved with locally.
• We also dedicate time and resources to contribute with our community through Corporate Volunteering activities, including our onsite HP Charity day.
• Do you like to give back to the community? Then join one of our many volunteering teams or be a part of the incredible HP charity day held on site annually.
• Love sports? Then take advantage of our sports center (indoor and outdoor) with 25+ regular coordinated activities.
• We have an onsite Doctor and medical team for our employees, including services such as: nutrition, physiotherapy, and general health.
• Printing Happy hour – from photographs to large posters. And Hands-on workshops to print with the latest technology – from wall covers to 3D printed models.
• Dedicated lactation room
• Our Women Network organizes activities such as Networking, the promotion of STEM vocations, talks on, improving business acumen, work life balance and skills of the future, etc

jobs_results.title: Power Converter Hardware Design Engineer
jobs_results.description:
It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters, join our global team.

Power converter component engineer for multimegawatt wind applications

Siemens Gamesa has a vision for renewable energy: we believe in the power of nature and technology. Help us to be ready to face the energy challenges of tomorrow and make a green footprint – join the team in creating a better future for us on our planet.

We focus on hiring the best people, wherever they may be in the world. We pride ourselves on the flexibility we offer to our employees and are committed to building a workforce that can grow with the company. Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

In our culture of trust, we focus on empowerment, diversity and continuous learning. Valuing our people is what makes... us one global team, with our colleagues’ safety at the heart of our organization.

Sponsored projects devoted to developing new performance improvements features, together with presales site specific tailoring of the wind turbines are demanding many load calculations in order to cover the demand.

How To Contribute To Our Vision

Deep knowledge of power electronics topologies and components:
• Converter modeling (PSIM, Matlab, PLECS) with focus on HW topics, including power topologies and component design.
• Review requirements, standards, and other documentation to clarify and understand converter hardware requirements.
• Technical specification and/or design report of main power components: heatsinks (air and water-cooled), busbars, capacitors, semiconductors, HW protections, filters, power cabling, cooling systems, etc.
• Thermal analysis of power converters (cooling concept and thermal modeling support).
• Power components validation.
• Contributions to double sourcing activities.
• Participate in converter validation to ensure compliance with the design requirements in cooperation with the whole converter design team.
• Adheres to the quality process through the execution of test procedures.
• Cooperates with other engineering teams to support product testing and certifications.
• Cooperates with other teams in the company to support presales, commissioning, aftersales, etc., including high-level product support.

What You Need To Make a Difference

Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change. We are also looking for…
• At least 3 years of experience in power electronics converter design (preferably high power, i.e. >100 kW)
• Experience in analysis, diagnosis and problem solving of power converters. Commissioning experience is also valuable.
• Fluent in Spanish and English.
• SW tools: Matlab and/or Python, Simulink and/or PSIM and/or PLECS.

Other Valuable Skills
• Methodical and practical approach in solving problems.
• Autonomy.
• Effective communication with co-workers and customers.
• Team work.
• Critical and logical thinking.

In return of your commitment we offer you…
• Become a part of our mission for sustainability: Clean energy for generations to come.
• A global team of diverse colleagues who share passion for renewable energy.
• Trust and empowerment to make your own ideas reality.
• Personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization.
• Flexible working hours as well as home-office (Important: add or remove this sentence depending on the position, legal entity or responsibilities).
• Attractive remuneration package.
• Local benefits such as subsided lunch, employee discounts and much more.

Empowering our people

https://www.siemensgamesa.com/sustainability/employees

How do you imagine the future?

https://youtu.be/12Sm678tjuY

Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions – the greatest challenge we face.

Severely disabled applicants are encouraged to reach out to us. We have inclusive recruiting processes specifically for severely disabled persons in Germany and we do our utmost to tailor working spaces to suit your individual needs. In cases of severe disability, applicants who are equally qualified will be given preferential consideration.

#gamesaelectric

Employment at Siemens Gamesa is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to job competence. Siemens Gamesa does not discriminate against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, ethnicity, nationality, ancestry, genetic information, citizenship, religion, age, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, rules or regulations. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, promotion and benefits.

We are driven by people - from more than 100 different countries, they build the company we are every day. Our diverse and inclusive culture encourages us to think outside the box, speak without fear, and be bold. We value the flexibility that our smart-working arrangements, our digital disconnection framework and our family-friendly practices bring to the new way of working

Conócenos

En ZITRO somos referentes en la industria del juego a nivel mundial. Desde su creación en 2007 no hemos parado de crecer y expandirnos por todo el mundo. ¿Nuestro secreto? Una apuesta constante en investigación, desarrollo, innovación tecnológica y en el mejor equipo humano con el que trabajar codo con codo. ¿Te animas?

Si te pica la curiosidad y quieres conocernos mejor, echa un vistazo: https://zitrogames.com/es/

Tu día a día en Zitro

Si están en búsqueda de un nuevo reto profesional dentro de un entorno dinámico, innovador y apasionante dónde desarrollar tus habilidades como Ingeniero de Hardware, ¡Has llegado al lugar correcto!

Formarás parte del departamento de Hardware y Systems participando en el diseño, desarrollo y mejora de nuestros productos, asegurando su calidad, rendimiento y seguridad.

Tus responsabilidades consistirán en:
• y homologar productos externos para su integración en nuestras máquinas.
• prototipos de nuevas máquinas o mejoras de las... existentes.
• e implementar metodologías de prueba de fabricación para garantizar la calidad y fiabilidad de los productos.
• componentes electrónicos y mecánicos de alta calidad para el uso en nuestras máquinas.
• con equipos transversales para garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad y seguridad.
• soporte técnico interno y externo para resolver problemas relacionados con el hardware de nuestras máquinas.
• a la investigación y desarrollo de nuevas tecnologías y tendencias en la industria de máquinas recreativas.

¿Qué necesitas para unirte a nuestro team?
• Experiencia mínima previa mínima de 5 años en posiciones similares.
• Buenos conocimientos de electrónica digital; circuitos analógicos.
• Experiencia en diseño de PCB.
• Conocimientos de EMC y EMI.
• Manejo instrumental de laboratorio.
• Programación microcontroladores y programación en C/C++ sobre Linux.
• Conocimientos en lenguaje ensamblador.

¿Qué suma puntos?
• en lógica programable, VHDL.
• alto de inglés.

Nuestra propuesta
• Fantástico ambiente laboral y diversión asegurada en los eventos regulares de Zitro Community.
• Contrato fijo que brindará estabilidad y confianza en tu trayectoria profesional.
• Horario flexible de lunes a jueves.
• Jornada continuada los viernes.
• Jornada de verano (julio y agosto).
• Ticket restaurante.
• Seguro de salud y de vida.
• Retribución flexible (tickets guardería
